write_up: Your resume tells a clear story: you moved from AmeriCorps tutoring into coordination and then management at Harbor Pathways. A recruiter can see the youth workforce work you manage, but has to ask how many students the program reaches and what it achieves.

The supervision line is the strongest starting point. It gives both groups of staff and their counts, so a recruiter can see your management remit. Naming what those staff handle would make it stronger still.

Let's start with the summer jobs program. Add its reach, then show what the team does and which participant results you track. Keep the grant reports and employer partnerships: they show important parts of the job.

cards.cannot_tell: The program is easy to picture, but a recruiter can't tell how many students or employers take part. Those counts matter when comparing program management roles.

cards.question: How many students and employers take part, and over what period?
